translations.EN: I cannot do that right now.
translations.TL: Hindi ko magagawa iyon ngayon.

translations.EN: That's not something I can pull off here.
translations.TL: Hindi ko magagawa 'yan dito.

translations.EN: Unable to execute that request at this time.
translations.TL: Di maisakatuparan ang hiling na 'yan sa ngayon.

translations.EN: I have to decline that order.
translations.TL: Kailangan kong tanggihan ang utos na 'yan.

translations.EN: Not possible under current circumstances.
translations.TL: Hindi posible sa kasalukuyang kalagayan.

translations.EN: I can't carry that out right now.
translations.TL: Di ko kayang isakatuparan 'yan ngayon.

translations.EN: Unable to comply with that command.
translations.TL: Di makasusunod sa utos na 'yan.

translations.EN: I can't do that. Find another solution.
translations.TL: Di ko magagawa 'yan. Humanap ng ibang solusyon.

translations.EN: Order declined. Conditions won't allow it.
translations.TL: Tinatanggihan ang utos. Di pinapayagan ng sitwasyon.

translations.EN: I cannot perform that action right now.
translations.TL: Hindi ko maisasagawa ang kilos na 'yan sa ngayon.

translations.EN: That order is not going to work.
translations.TL: Hindi uubra ang utos na iyan.

translations.EN: That's a bad plan and it won't succeed.
translations.TL: Masamang plano 'yan at hindi magtatagumpay.

translations.EN: That order makes no sense in this situation.
translations.TL: Walang saysay ang utos na 'yan sa sitwasyong ito.

translations.EN: That won't work. We need a different approach.
translations.TL: Hindi uubra 'yan. Kailangan natin ng ibang diskarte.

translations.EN: I'm not following an order that leads to failure.
translations.TL: Di ako susunod sa utos na papunta sa kapahamakan.

translations.EN: That command will only get us killed.
translations.TL: Ipapahamak lang tayo ng utos na 'yan.

translations.EN: Not going to work out. Try another idea.
translations.TL: Hindi magiging maayos 'yan. Sumubok ng ibang ideya.

translations.EN: Flawed order. I won't execute it.
translations.TL: May depekto ang utos. Di ko isasakatuparan.

translations.EN: That plan is dead in the water.
translations.TL: Patay ang planong 'yan sa simula pa lang.

translations.EN: That won't work out here. Give a better order.
translations.TL: Di uubra 'yan dito. Magbigay ka ng mas maayos na utos.
